q1_issues.issue: The 'without tackling stairs' adjunct is asserted as a top-level strength-0.0 denial, which claims John Paul did not tackle stairs; the tackling sits inside an unasserted purpose clause, whose non-finite eventualities must assert or deny nothing about occurrence.
The denied tackling event is left floating — nothing links it to the board/descend events it modifies.

The allow event's Agent is the mini-lift, but the purpose infinitive's implicit subject defaults to the matrix subject (the Vatican) under subject control; the lift-as-allower reading is not read off the words.
The coordinated complements 'to board and descend' are put on one allow event as two same-role Theme atoms, whereas coordinated VPs are to be translated as independent conjuncts.

q2_gaps: 'without V-ing' adjunct (a negated accompanying/manner clause) — no licensed encoding; Without is available as an entity/event oblique only for an NP object, and the negation machinery covers only clause-level denial
coordinated non-finite complements under one matrix verb ('allow X to board and descend') — the coordination rule addresses clauses/VPs and NPs, not shared-matrix infinitival conjuncts
the allowee of a permission verb ('allow John Paul to board') — the periphrastic-causative list is have/get/make/let, so it is not stated whether allow puts the object only in the caused event
notes: The purpose infinitive is correctly rendered as (To <main> <purpose>) with the main clause first, and the shared helicopter symbol is reused across the board and descend events.
